parsed.post: Discarding the latest result (1.012425) as it regressed from my best (1.006925). The experiment with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 seems to have caused instability or poor convergence for this specific configuration. Reverting to my best and will now try reducing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.01 to see if regularization helps.
parsed.description: Testing a small non-zero WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.01 on my best configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288) to see if regularization aids convergence.
